parts.zh: M: 您是牛津大学的物理学教授
W: 哦，是这样，我就是热爱自己所做的事情
M: 教授，您的目标究竟是什么？您为什么要做这一切？
M: 这两件事不会互相妨碍吗？我的意思是
M: 您认为近期会出现什么科学突破吗？比如我们很快就能期待的重大​​发现或发明？
W: 世界各地一直都在进行科学研究

items.stem: Why does the woman say she can be so energetic?

choices.text: She can devote all her life to pursuing her passion.
choices.zh: 她可以倾其一生追求自己的热爱。

choices.text: Her accumulated expertise helps her to achieve her goals.
choices.zh: 她积累的专业知识帮助她实现目标。

choices.text: She can spread her academic ideas on a weekly TV show.
choices.zh: 她可以在每周的电视节目上传播自己的学术思想。

choices.text: Her research findings are widely acclaimed in the world.
choices.zh: 她的研究成果在世界范围内广受赞誉。

items.stem: What has the woman been engaged in?

choices.text: Provision of guidance for nuclear labs in Europe.
choices.zh: 为欧洲的核实验室提供指导。

choices.text: Touring the globe to attend science TV shows.
choices.zh: 环游世界参加科学电视节目。

choices.text: Overseeing two research groups at Oxford.
choices.zh: 在牛津大学监管两个研究小组。

choices.text: Science education and scientific research.
choices.zh: 科学教育和科学研究。

items.stem: What does the woman say about the benefit teaching brings to her?

choices.text: A better understanding of a subject.
choices.zh: 对某一学科有更深入的理解。

choices.text: A stronger will to meet challenges.
choices.zh: 迎接挑战的意志更加坚强。

choices.text: A broader knowledge of related fields.
choices.zh: 对相关领域有更广泛的了解。

choices.text: A closer relationship with young people.
choices.zh: 与年轻人建立更紧密的关系。

items.stem: How does the woman say new scientific breakthroughs can be made possible?

choices.text: By applying the latest research methods.
choices.zh: 通过应用最新的研究方法。

choices.text: By making full use of the existing data.
choices.zh: 通过充分利用现有数据。

choices.text: By building upon previous discoveries.
choices.zh: 通过在先前发现的基础上进行研究。

choices.text: By utilizing more powerful computers.
choices.zh: 通过使用更强大的计算机。

items.stem: What do both speakers think of dreams?

choices.text: They can predict future events.
choices.zh: 梦能够预测未来事件。

choices.text: They have no special meanings.
choices.zh: 梦没有特殊含义。

choices.text: They have cultural connotations.
choices.zh: 梦具有文化内涵。

choices.text: They cannot be easily explained.
choices.zh: 梦无法轻易解释。

items.stem: Why didn't the woman's grandmother take her scheduled flight?

choices.text: It was canceled due to bad weather.
choices.zh: 航班因恶劣天气被取消了。

choices.text: She overslept and missed the flight.
choices.zh: 她睡过头了,错过了航班。

choices.text: She dreamed of a plane crash.
choices.zh: 她梦到了飞机失事。

choices.text: It was postponed to the following day.
choices.zh: 航班被推迟到第二天。

items.stem: What does the woman say about people's emotions?

choices.text: They can be affected by people's childhood experiences.
choices.zh: 情绪可能会受到人童年经历的影响。

choices.text: They may sometimes seem ridiculous to a rational mind.
choices.zh: 情绪有时在理性思维看来可能显得荒谬。

choices.text: They usually result from people's unpleasant memories.
choices.zh: 情绪通常源于人的不愉快记忆。

choices.text: They can have an impact as great as rational thinking.
choices.zh: 情绪可以产生与理性思维同样大的影响。

items.stem: What did psychologist Sigmund Freud say about adults' dreams?

choices.text: They call for scientific methods to interpret.
choices.zh: 梦需要科学方法来解释。

choices.text: They mirror their long-cherished wishes.
choices.zh: 梦反映了人们长久以来珍视的愿望。

choices.text: They reflect their complicated emotions.
choices.zh: 梦反映了人们复杂的情绪。

choices.text: They are often related to irrational feelings.
choices.zh: 梦常常与非理性情感有关。

items.stem: What did scientists first use to discover Lake Vostok in the 1970s?

choices.text: Radio waves.
choices.zh: 无线电波。

choices.text: Sound waves.
choices.zh: 声波。

choices.text: Robots.
choices.zh: 机器人。

choices.text: Satellites.
choices.zh: 卫星。

items.stem: What do scientists think about Lake Vostok?

choices.text: It may be freezing fast beneath the glacier.
choices.zh: 它可能正在冰川下快速冻结。

choices.text: It may have micro-organisms living in it.
choices.zh: 它可能有微生物生活在其中。

choices.text: It may have certain rare minerals in it.
choices.zh: 它可能含有某些稀有矿物质。

choices.text: It may be as deep as four kilometers.
choices.zh: 它可能深达四公里。

items.stem: What do the scientists hope their discoveries will do?

choices.text: Help understand life in freezing conditions.
choices.zh: 帮助理解冰冻条件下的生命。

choices.text: Help find new sources of fresh water.
choices.zh: 帮助找到新的淡水来源。

choices.text: Provide information about other planets.
choices.zh: 提供有关其他行星的信息。

choices.text: Shed light on possible life in outer space.
choices.zh: 揭示外层空间可能存在生命的线索。

items.stem: Why did James Copeland want to study the American Indian tribe Tarahumaras?

choices.text: He found there had been little research on their language.
choices.zh: 他发现对他们的语言几乎没有研究。

choices.text: He was trying to preserve the languages of the Indian tribes.
choices.zh: 他试图保护印第安部落的语言。

choices.text: His contact with a social worker had greatly aroused his interest in the tribe.
choices.zh: 他与一名社会工作者的接触极大地激发了他对该部落的兴趣。

choices.text: His meeting with Gonzalez had made him eager to learn more about the tribe.
choices.zh: 他与 Gonzalez 的会面使他渴望更多地了解该部落。

items.stem: How did Gonzalez help James Copeland?

choices.text: He taught Copeland to speak the Tarahumaras language.
choices.zh: 他教 Copeland 说 Tarahumaras 语。

choices.text: He persuaded the Tarahumaras to accept Copeland's gifts.
choices.zh: 他说服 Tarahumaras 人接受 Copeland 的礼物。

choices.text: He recommended one of his best friends as an interpreter.
choices.zh: 他推荐了他最好的朋友之一担任口译员。

choices.text: He acted as an intermediary between Copeland and the villagers.
choices.zh: 他在 Copeland 和村民之间充当中间人。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about James Copeland's trip to the Tarahumaras village?

choices.text: Unpredictable.
choices.zh: 不可预测的。

choices.text: Unjustifiable.
choices.zh: 不合理的。

choices.text: Laborious.
choices.zh: 艰苦的。

choices.text: Tedious.
choices.zh: 乏味的。

items.stem: What impresses James Copeland about the Tarahumaras tribe?

choices.text: Their appreciation of help from the outsiders.
choices.zh: 他们对外来者帮助的感激。

choices.text: Their sense of sharing and caring.
choices.zh: 他们的分享与关怀意识。

choices.text: Their readiness to adapt to technology.
choices.zh: 他们适应技术的准备。

choices.text: Their belief in creating wealth for themselves.
choices.zh: 他们为自己创造财富的信念。

items.stem: What usually happens when people are accused of being radical?

choices.text: They tend to be silenced into submission.
choices.zh: 他们往往会被迫沉默屈服。

choices.text: They find it hard to defend themselves.
choices.zh: 他们发现很难为自己辩护。

choices.text: They will feel proud of being pioneers.
choices.zh: 他们会为成为先驱者感到自豪。

choices.text: They will feel somewhat encouraged.
choices.zh: 他们会感到某种程度的鼓舞。

items.stem: What is the speaker's definition of a radical?

choices.text: One who advocates violence in effecting change.
choices.zh: 主张用暴力实现变革的人。

choices.text: One who craves for relentless transformations,
choices.zh: 渴望不断变革的人。

choices.text: One who acts in the interests of the oppressed.
choices.zh: 为受压迫者的利益行动的人。

choices.text: One who rebels against the existing social order.
choices.zh: 反抗现有社会秩序的人。

items.stem: What does the speaker think of most radicals in the American history?

choices.text: They tried to effect social change by force.
choices.zh: 他们试图用武力实现社会变革。

choices.text: They disrupted the nation's social stability.
choices.zh: 他们破坏了国家的社会稳定。

choices.text: They served as a driving force for progress.
choices.zh: 他们充当了进步的推动力量。

choices.text: They did more harm than good to humanity.
choices.zh: 他们对人类的害处大于益处。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about us as human beings?

choices.text: Few of us can ignore changes in our immediate environment.
choices.zh: 我们中很少有人能够忽视我们周围环境中的变化。

choices.text: It is impossible for us to be immune from outside influence.
choices.zh: 我们不可能不受外界影响。

choices.text: Few of us can remain unaware of what happens around us.
choices.zh: 我们中很少有人能够对周围发生的事情毫无察觉。

choices.text: It is important for us to keep in touch with our own world.
choices.zh: 对我们来说，与自己的世界保持联系是重要的。

items.stem: What does the speaker say Fred should do first to improve his quality of life?

choices.text: Make up his mind to start all over again.
choices.zh: 下定决心重新开始。

choices.text: Stop making unfair judgements of others.
choices.zh: 停止对他人做出不公正的评判。

choices.text: Try to find a more exciting job somewhere else.
choices.zh: 尝试在别处找一份更令人兴奋的工作。

choices.text: Recognise the negative impact of his coworkers.
choices.zh: 认识到他同事的负面影响。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about psychiatrists?

choices.text: They are quite susceptible to suicide.
choices.zh: 他们相当容易自杀。

choices.text: They improve people's quality of life.
choices.zh: 他们改善人们的生活质量。

choices.text: They suffer a great deal from ill health.
choices.zh: 他们深受健康不良之苦。

choices.text: They help people solve mental problems.
choices.zh: 他们帮助人们解决心理问题。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the American dollar bill?

choices.text: Few people can identify its texture.
choices.zh: 很少有人能识别它的质地。

choices.text: Few people can describe it precisely.
choices.zh: 很少有人能准确描述它。

choices.text: Its real value is open to interpretation.
choices.zh: 它的真实价值可以有不同的解读。

choices.text: Its importance is often over-estimated.
choices.zh: 它的重要性常常被高估。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the exact composition of the American dollar bill?

choices.text: It has never seen any change.
choices.zh: 它从未发生过任何变化。

choices.text: It has much to do with color.
choices.zh: 它与颜色有很大关系。

choices.text: It is a well-protected government secret.
choices.zh: 它是政府严密保护的秘密。

choices.text: It is a subject of study by many forgers.
choices.zh: 它是许多伪造者研究的对象。

items.stem: Why did the new American government mint only coins for common currency?

choices.text: People had little faith in paper money.
choices.zh: 人们对纸币缺乏信心。

choices.text: They could last longer in circulation.
choices.zh: 它们在流通中能保存更久。

choices.text: It predicted their value would increase.
choices.zh: 它预测它们的价值会增长。

choices.text: They were more difficult to counterfeit.
choices.zh: 它们更难被伪造。

items.stem: What have generations of American politicians argued for?

choices.text: The stabilization of the dollar value.
choices.zh: 稳定美元价值。

choices.text: The issuing of government securities.
choices.zh: 发行政府证券。

choices.text: A gold standard for American currency.
choices.zh: 美国货币采用金本位制。

choices.text: A steady appreciation of the U.S. dollar.
choices.zh: 美元稳步升值。
